preconditions.description: The number of plates is between 1 and 2000.
The maximum number of plates that can be taken from the dirty stack and the intermediate stack are both between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The output indicates whether Nikita can sort the plates in the dryer.

postconditions.expression: if output is 'YES', then there exists a sequence of operations that sorts the plates
postconditions.description: If Nikita can sort the plates, the output includes the sequence of operations.

postconditions.expression: if output is 'NO', then no sequence of operations can sort the plates
postconditions.description: If Nikita cannot sort the plates, the output indicates this.

invariants.expression: The order of plates in the dirty stack is down up
invariants.description: The plates are initially placed in the dirty stack in decreasing order.

invariants.expression: The order of plates in the intermediate stack and dryer are up down
invariants.description: The plates are placed in the intermediate and dryer stacks in increasing order.
